Definition: Sin the name of an Egyptian town and (probably) desert adjoining
BiblicalUsage: Sin is the wilderness between Elim and Sinai, where Israel comes on the fifteenth day of the second month after leaving Egypt. The whole congregation murmurs there for bread, and God gives them manna. The name appears in the journey lists as a stage on the way to the mountain.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wilderness of Sin matters because it is where God feeds a murmuring people, and His provision does not wait for their gratitude.
RelatedEvents: Manna and Quail in the Wilderness
